name: Ouarzazate
hero_subtitle: Kasbahs, film sets and the gateway between the High Atlas and the desert roads.

info.vibe_val: Desert edge, kasbahs and Morocco’s film town
info.airport_val: OZZ Ouarzazate · Road from Marrakech (~4–5 h)

overview.title: Welcome to Ouarzazate — gateway to the desert
overview.p1: Ouarzazate sits where the High Atlas opens toward the pre-Saharan plateaus. Kasbah Taourirt anchors the town; Atlas Studios and Aït Benhaddou explain why this place became a film and heritage landmark.
overview.p2: Two or three days cover the town kasbah, the studios and Aït Benhaddou, with time for Fint oasis or Tifoultoute.

places.title: Must-visit places in Ouarzazate
places.subtitle: Kasbahs, film sets, a UNESCO ksar and palm oases.

taourirt.name: Kasbah Taourirt
taourirt.desc: Former Glaoui stronghold and desert-edge landmark.

ait-benhaddou.name: Aït Benhaddou
ait-benhaddou.desc: Famous earthen ksar on the old caravan route.

tifoultoute.name: Kasbah Tifoultoute
tifoultoute.desc: Hilltop kasbah with wide views and a quieter feel.

cinema-museum.name: Cinema Museum
cinema-museum.desc: Costumes and the story of filming in Ouarzazate.

skoura.name: Skoura Oasis
skoura.desc: Wide palm grove and kasbahs toward the Dadès.

stays.title: Where to stay in Ouarzazate? Our favorites
stays.subtitle: Palace comfort in town, boutique riads, and a calm palm-grove lodge toward Skoura.

card1.name: Le Berbère Palace
card1.desc: Landmark palace hotel with pools, gardens and polished service — the classic upscale base in Ouarzazate.

card2.name: Dar Chamaa
card2.desc: Elegant boutique house with clay architecture, quiet patio and refined rooms close to the centre.

card3.name: Riad Dar Sofian
card3.desc: Traditional riad comfort with warm décor, terrace views and a calm base for kasbahs and studios.

card4.name: Les Jardins de Skoura
card4.desc: Peaceful lodge among palm groves east of town — ideal for quiet nights and Dadès routes.

eat.title: Where to eat in Ouarzazate
eat.subtitle: Family tajines in town, terraces at Aït Benhaddou and simple local tables — not nightlife spots.

nomad.title: Restaurant Douyria
nomad.desc: Traditional Moroccan restaurant near the kasbah area — tajines, couscous and a local family atmosphere.

jardin.title: La Datte d'Or
jardin.desc: Well-rated Moroccan tables in town — tajines, kefta and generous portions for families.

fassia.title: Terrasses d'Aït Benhaddou
fassia.desc: Lunch terraces facing the ksar — tajines with the UNESCO view, best at midday.

moha.title: Restaurant Toudgha
moha.desc: Local favourite for homemade Moroccan dishes, tajines and friendly service at fair prices.

bacha.title: Café Restaurant Sabrine
bacha.desc: Café-restaurant for Moroccan meals and tea — practical stop after the kasbah or a long drive.

elfenn.title: Table d'hôtes Skoura
elfenn.desc: Fixed menus in palm-grove guesthouses — quiet dinners on the road to the Dadès.

booking_banner.title: Explore all stays in Ouarzazate
booking_banner.desc: Compare real-time rates, read verified guest reviews, and discover more kasbahs, riads and hotels.

transport.title: Getting around
transport.desc: Petit taxis in town; private drivers for Aït Benhaddou, Skoura and Fint.

bargain.title: Sun & altitude
bargain.desc: Strong sun and dry air. Nights can be cold.

water.title: Day trips
water.desc: Aït Benhaddou is essential. Skoura, Dadès and Draa need more time.

daytrips.title: Day trips from Ouarzazate
daytrips.subtitle: UNESCO ksar, palm oases and the first gorges of the east.

ait_benhaddou.name: Aït Benhaddou
ait_benhaddou.desc: UNESCO ksar about 30–40 minutes away — the region’s signature day stop.

dades.name: Dadès Gorge
dades.desc: Road of kasbahs and dramatic gorge landscapes east of Skoura.

draa.name: Draa Valley
draa.desc: Palm corridor and kasbahs south toward Zagora for a longer day or overnight.

q1.question: How many days in Ouarzazate?
q1.answer: Two full days cover Taourirt, Atlas Studios and Aït Benhaddou. A third day suits Fint, Skoura or the start of a desert route.

q2.question: Is Ouarzazate only a stopover?
q2.answer: It is a logistics hub, but the kasbah, studios and Aït Benhaddou justify one or two nights on their own.

q3.question: How do I get to Ouarzazate?
q3.answer: Ouarzazate Airport (OZZ) has limited flights. Most travellers arrive by road from Marrakech (about 4–5 hours) or continue from the desert circuit.

q4.question: Best time to visit Ouarzazate?
q4.answer: Spring and autumn for milder days. Summer is very hot; winter is clear but cold at night.

itinerary.title: 3 days in Ouarzazate
itinerary.subtitle: Town and studios, then Aït Benhaddou, then an oasis or the road east.

detailed_itinerary.day1_md: Walk the courtyards and terraces of the Glaoui kasbah on the edge of town.
detailed_itinerary.day1_ad: Tour the outdoor sets that made Ouarzazate a film centre.
detailed_itinerary.day1_ed: Simple dinner in the centre; rest early if tomorrow is Aït Benhaddou.
detailed_itinerary.day2_md: Leave early for the UNESCO ksar; climb for the classic panorama.
detailed_itinerary.day2_ad: Explore the fortified village then lunch on the modern bank.
detailed_itinerary.day2_ed: Return to town; Cinema Museum optional.
detailed_itinerary.day3_md: Palms and village paths, or a quieter hilltop kasbah.
detailed_itinerary.day3_ad: Oasis toward the Dadès, or shopping and rest in town.
detailed_itinerary.day3_ed: Toward Dadès or Draa/Zagora or back to Marrakech depending on your route.
